subject: DeltaHealth: request to delay backup purge, subprocessor evidence and DPA addendum
messages:
From: Susan Lee <susan.lee@deltahealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Cc: DeltaHealth Procurement <procurement@deltahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Jun 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request to delay backup purge + DPA addendum for subprocessor evidence

Hi Kimberly,

We're running a scheduled clinical audit next week and discovered that a subset of logs and nightly backups that would be purged on 2028-06-14 contain records we need to preserve for the audit evidence chain. Can Redwood put a temporary hold on the standard 30-day purge for buckets associated with our account (DeltaHealth: acct-00921) until 2028-07-01?

Separately, our legal/compliance team asks for an addendum to the DPA that: (1) requires Redwood to provide a subprocessor manifest for any backup/archival subprocessor used for these snapshots, and (2) provides exportable proof-of-deletion and chain-of-custody artifacts after the extended purge runs. I've attached an audit_request.pdf that outlines what our auditors will need.

We appreciate a quick confirmation of whether you can accommodate a one-time hold and the documentation we should expect. This is time-sensitive for the audit schedule.

Thanks,
Susan Lee
Sr. IT Compliance Manager
DeltaHealth

Attachment: audit_request.pdf (PDF, 210 KB)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Susan Lee <susan.lee@deltahealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Jun 2028 10:04:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to delay backup purge + DPA addendum for subprocessor evidence

Susan — thanks for the note and the attachment. We can accommodate a temporary hold as an operational matter, but we'll need legal and security to confirm the DPA/addendum path and the exact evidence we can provide. Looping in:

- Aditya (pre-sales) so we can capture the account and runbook details for ops
- Marissa (Security) to confirm what chain-of-custody artifacts are available from our backup provider and our retention tooling
- Karthik (Legal) to advise on DPA addendum language and DocuSign flow

Quick asks to keep this moving:
1) Can you confirm the exact buckets/ARNs and the types of logs/backups you want held?
2) Is 2028-07-01 the hard deadline for purge (i.e., we must restore to standard cadence on that date)?
3) Any specific audit format or manifest template you require?

We'll target a reply with a proposed runbook and DPA redline by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Susan Lee <susan.lee@deltahealth.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Jun 2028 09:30:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to delay backup purge + DPA addendum for subprocessor evidence

Hi Susan and team,

Thanks for the context — we can do a DPA addendum to memorialize a one-time extension and clarify the subprocessor evidence we can provide. To make progress, please see the list below of items we'll need from DeltaHealth and what Redwood can commit to: 

DeltaHealth -> please provide:
- Exact S3 bucket ARNs or project IDs for the snapshots/log streams to be retained
- A target purge date (you proposed 2028-07-01; confirm if flexible)
- The specific audit fields and manifest format preferred (CSV with columns: object_key, last_modified, checksum, subprocessor_location is fine)

Redwood -> we can commit to:
- A temporary operational hold on the listed backup sets through the agreed date
- An exported manifest for the held objects with object_key, timestamp, SHA256 checksum, and storage tier
- Post-purge proof: a signed deletion confirmation file and a retention-to-deletion timeline showing who invoked the purge and when (redacted for unrelated accounts)

Limitations/notes: we cannot include third-party internal backups hosted by a customer-managed subprocessor; if DeltaHealth uses a separate archival vendor we don't control, we will need evidence from that subprocessor as well. Also, please note that proof-of-deletion artifacts for immutable offsite escrow providers may follow that provider's SLA (we will surface that in the addendum).

I've drafted a short addendum that captures the above and includes a DocuSign link for execution once details are confirmed: https://docusign.example.com/ABC-Delta-DPA-Addendum

If that looks reasonable, please confirm the bucket ARNs and we will route to Ops to implement the temporary hold today.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security
Redwood Inference

From: Susan Lee <susan.lee@deltahealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Cc: DeltaHealth Procurement <procurement@deltahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Jun 2028 11:47:30 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to delay backup purge + DPA addendum for subprocessor evidence

Hi Karthik / Kimberly — thanks for the quick turnaround. Attached is a minimal manifest and the ARNs for the sets we need held. We can live with 2028-07-01 as the purge date; the audit completes on 2028-06-28 but our auditors asked for a 72-hour buffer.

Attachments: delta_evidence_manifest.csv (CSV, 14 KB) — columns: object_key,last_modified,checksum,storage_tier

Quick answers inline:
- Buckets/ARNs: arn:aws:s3:::delta-prod-logs-2028, arn:aws:s3:::delta-nightly-snapshots
- Purge date: confirm 2028-07-01 as hard stop
- Manifest format: the attached CSV is fine

We will sign the addendum after your legal team issues the final text; Procurement is standing by for the DocuSign link. Appreciate the operational assistance here.

Regards,
Susan Lee
Sr. IT Compliance Manager
DeltaHealth

Attachment: delta_evidence_manifest.csv

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Jun 2028 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to delay backup purge + DPA addendum for subprocessor evidence — operational confirmation

Team — ops has implemented a temporary hold for the two ARNs Susan provided. Summary of actions taken and next steps: 

- Hold scope: arn:aws:s3:::delta-prod-logs-2028 and arn:aws:s3:::delta-nightly-snapshots — objects dated 2028-05-01 through 2028-06-14 (inclusive)
- Export: generated manifest (CSV) with object_key,last_modified,SHA256,storage_tier and uploaded to a secure share for DeltaHealth
- Proof-of-deletion: scheduled post-purge job will generate a signed deletion record and timeline; operations will place the signed file in the same secure share and notify both parties
- Runbook: ops created a short runbook for the temporary-retain workflow: https://drive.redwood.com/ops/runbooks/temp-retain-202806 (internal link)

Attachments: ops-temporary-hold-runbook.md

Notes/constraints:
- If DeltaHealth needs the manifest signed by a third-party auditor, that will be an extra step and may require coordination with their audit provider.
- Any change to the 2028-07-01 purge date needs 48 hours notice to avoid partial-run races.

Kimberly — please confirm if you want me to reply to DeltaHealth with the runbook link and expected timelines, and Karthik — please advise when the DocuSign addendum is ready so we can close the loop with Procurement.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Security Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachment: ops-temporary-hold-runbook.md
